forced.interpretation: same_letter_rate near 0 means the chosen revision stayed the same while the letter flipped, i.e. content-driven answers; near 1 means the same letter was chosen in both orders, i.e. position-following; near 0.5 is consistent with a random letter choice. Accuracy must be read alongside this rate, because a stable but wrong semantic choice also produces a rate near 0.
